items.title: Shimmer: Dreaming the Posthuman
items.summary: This thought-provoking exhibition at the Frist Art Museum explores human interconnectedness with the more-than-human world.

items.title: What Happens After Repatriation?
items.summary: “Tide of Returns” investigates the histories and futures of handmade dolls repatriated to an Indigenous Australian community.

items.title: What Can Photographs Say in a World Full of Images?
items.summary: An exhibition at the Wellin Museum of Art at Hamilton College examines how artists utilize serial configurations of pictures and text to prompt questions about seeing.
